apps.localizedDescription:
YouTube 21.45.4 | YTKACE_21.45.4_1.1.5

### Latest Release, ENJOY!!
#### A YouTube enhancer for iOS with downloads, iSponsorBlock, DeArrow, player controls, and interface customization.
> [!NOTE]
> - 📝[v1.1.5 release notes](https://github.com/itzzace/ytkace/releases/tag/v1.1.5)
> - 🔽Set Download Button to Both in settings to enable Downloads. 
> - 📺 Functional YT Cast 
> - Temporary release until YTKACE releases new update.
>
> - - -
>
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` `YTweaks`
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `VolumeBoostYT` `Gonerino`
